title: Toxic Language Detection in Social Media for Brazilian Portuguese: New Dataset and Multilingual Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating BERT-based classifiers on a newly annotated Brazilian Portuguese dataset to detect LGBTQ+phobia, including an error analysis of false negative rates across demographic categories.
Measuring the performance of language models in detecting misogynistic hate speech within tweets through multi-label classification and analyzing class-specific error rates.
Annotating tweets for racism and evaluating the false negative rates of toxicity classifiers to highlight the impact of data imbalance on detecting racial abuse.

Assessing classifier performance and error rates in detecting xenophobic tweets, specifically including regional prejudices in Brazil (e.g., against Northeasterners), using multi-label and binary classification.
